name: "Freezer-Friendly" Baked Oatmeal Squares with Almonds & Blueberries (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 350°F. Coat an 8-inch square baking dish with a thin layer of butter.

Melt additional butter in a small saucepan or microwave-safe bowl. Once melted, transfer to a medium mixing bowl along with milk, maple syrup, egg, and vanilla, then whisk to combine the wet ingredients.
instructions.secondary_message:
butter, unsalted
2 cups whole milk
⅓ cup pure maple syrup
1 egg
2 tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Place oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt in another medium bowl, then stir to combine. Add dry ingredients to the bowl with the wet ingredients and stir once more. Transfer oatmeal to the baking dish and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups oats, old fashioned
1 tsp baking powder
1 tsp cinnamon, ground
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry blueberries. Sprinkle blueberries and almonds over the oatmeal.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (170 g) pkg blueberries
¼ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until oats are set in the center, 35-40 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour.

STORING: Once the baked oatmeal is cool, cut into portions and divide between storage containers or resealable bags. Place in the refrigerator for up to 5 days or freeze for up to 1 month. 

REHEATING: For best results, if frozen, thaw baked oatmeal in the fridge overnight. Heat portions in the microwave, air fryer, or toaster oven until warmed through. Drizzle with additional maple syrup (if desired) and enjoy!
